digest.component_or_area: CLI mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, transition, etc.)
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs exit 0 silently on success today, making successful writes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops, forcing agents to issue follow-up store reads for verification
Silent success causes agents to misinterpret results and file spurious bugs or retry operations unnecessarily

All in-scope mutating verbs must emit uniform one-line confirmations describing the state change (e.g. 'linked X -> Y', 'no change: already linked X -> Y') to stdout on both write and idempotent no-op paths, exiting 0 both ways

Global `--quiet` and `--output` flags must be extracted at the router before partition dispatch to ensure all verbs including positional-only leaves support them consistently, with `--quiet` suppressing confirmations and `--output json` emitting a structured envelope

Existing consumers like REDIRECT records and rebar_reconciler/conflict_bug_filing.py must be updated to preserve byte-identical output contracts or migrate to `--output json`, and already-printing verbs must normalize to the shared contract without information loss

Every verb's confirmation must be built only from CLI args and seam outcome (no follow-up store reads), and seam return contracts consumed by facades must remain unchanged while unconsumed None returns gain parallel outcome signals
